end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting scientific statements into observations, hypotheses, laws and theories, using everyday examples. Tara gave clear examples of an observation and a testable hypothesis, and described a law as a repeated rule. The mix-up that theories turn into laws was still present at the end; at home, ask Tara to explain how a scientific theory and law answer different kinds of questions.
